info.title: Exende Resolve API
info.description: Resolve public resources into stable, machine-readable results for autonomous software.

post.summary: Resolve a public URL into machine-readable content.
post.description: Requires one x402 v2 exact USDC payment on Base. Repeat the same payment identifier to safely recover an interrupted paid request.

202.description: The paid Resolve job is still processing.

400.description: The request or URL is invalid.

402.description: An x402 payment is required or could not settle.

409.description: The payment identifier conflicts or is in progress.

get.summary: Read a Resolve result with its job-scoped read token.

200.description: The current Resolve state or result.

401.description: A valid Resolve read token is required.

404.description: The Resolve job does not exist.
